title_zh: 约定俱乐部秘书辞职日期和交接清单

scenario.label_zh: 俱乐部秘书退休搬家交接
scenario.goal_zh: 明确秘书将在月底辞职，约定先列出交接清单再寻找接任者

context_zh: 虚构社区俱乐部中，现任秘书与主席商量离任交接，尚未向全体成员发送通知。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: My retirement starts next month, and I will be moving closer to my daughter.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Does that mean you want to leave the club committee as well?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Yes. I need to resign as secretary at the end of this month.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: Thank you for telling me early. Could you list the monthly tasks and where the records are kept?

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Certainly. I'll have a handover list ready by Friday, but I don't know anyone who could take over.

sentences.speaker: Bea
sentences.text: That is fine. Let's use your list to explain the role before we ask for volunteers.

sentences.speaker: Arthur
sentences.text: Agreed. I will stay responsible for the records until the last day of the month.
